meta.name: atlassian-templates
meta.description: Atlassian Template and Files Creator/Modifier expert for creating, modifying, and managing Jira and Confluence templates, blueprints, custom layouts, reusable components, and standardized content structures. Use when building org-wide templates, custom blueprints, page layouts, and automated content generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和管理团队模板与内容结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Jira和Confluence中统一团队模板和内容格式。
copy.tagline_en: Create and manage team templates and content structures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to standardize templates and content in Jira and Confluence.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、修改和管理 Jira 和 Confluence 的模板、蓝图、自定义布局和可复用组件，确保内容一致并符合组织标准。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建组织级模板、自定义蓝图、页面布局或自动化内容生成时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个会议记录模板，包含议程、决策和行动项。
更新项目章程模板，添加状态宏和截止日期。
say.note: Claude 会修改现有模板并保留旧版本。

say.text: 为 Jira 创建一个用户故事模板，包含验收标准和定义完成。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Jira 问题描述模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, modify, and manage reusable templates and files for Jira and Confluence, including blueprints, custom layouts, and standardized content structures, ensuring consistency and org-wide standards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users request building org-wide templates, custom blueprints, page layouts, or automated content generation.

say_en.text: Create a meeting notes template with agenda, decisions, and action items.
Update the project charter template to add status macro and due dates.
say_en.note: Claude modifies the template and keeps the old version.

say_en.text: Create a user story template for Jira with acceptance criteria and definition of done.
say_en.note: Claude generates a Jira issue description template.
